description: Conditions triaged as lower priority - eyes, urology, orthopaedics - deteriorate while they wait, and arrive later as the emergency they were not when first referred.
energy_note: Waiting until it qualifies as serious.

aspect: Women's conditions cluster in the lower-priority specialties
description: Gynaecological, urological and chronic pain conditions are precisely the categories least likely to be treated as urgent by a permit system, and the ones most likely to be under-reported by the patient in the first place.
energy_note: A system that ranks what women mostly present with, low.
